detailed_descriptions.en: Prepare for close confrontation with a new character look and bolstered artillery of heavy fire weapons. Equip the Win & Co 1885, a heavy-hitting rifle that despite its restricted rate of fire, houses an enormous .50 calibre 50-110 round, capable of eliminating any enemy in its path with a single shot. Complimenting the Win & Co 1885 is the ERMA.36, a submachine gun that features an integral suppressor and high muzzle velocity, making for a heavy but powerful stealth SMG. Available in both Karl and Monika variants, the Tank Top Character Skin features brown leather accents and a rough and ready combat look for traversing the battlefield. Included in this pack: • Win & Co 1885 – Weapon Pack (Rifle + Attachments) • ERMA.36 – Weapon Pack (Submachine Gun + Attachments) • Tank Top - Character Skin (Karl and Monika variants)
